messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate after deploy panorama-2026-03-17-07. p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.4s, p99 ~ 7.1s. Error rate +12% over baseline. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/panorama/deploy/18123
DeployBot: Deployed panorama-2026-03-17-07 at 1812345600 by @maria_g. Canary was 5% -> now full rollout.
Tom (oncall): I'm on it, taking pager. Observing gateway timeouts and some upstream 502s. Routing shows increased queue depth on gpu-pool-3.
Maria (SRE): Seeing a correlation w/ kernel flag change in runtime v0.9.3 that landed in that deploy (kv-affinity tweak). Profiling KB shows longer KV lock holds under burst.
Ashok (infra): Confirmed. Metrics: kv_lock_hold_time 99th jumped x6 since 1812345600. Also connection churn on node-7.
Tom (oncall): Immediate mitigation options? Ideas: rollback, shadow-release, emergency config revert.
Lena (SRE Lead): Prioritize rollback to avoid customer impact. If rollback fast, do it. @Tom please coordinate with @Maria for rollback steps.
Tom (oncall): @Maria can you prepare rollback plan. I'll page CS after rollback if stable.
Maria (SRE): Rollback plan: 1) halt rollout (DeployBot) 2) roll back runtime to v0.9.2 on pool gpu-pool-3 3) restart workers with graceful drain 4) monitor p95/p99 + 5xx. Command: ```deployctl rollback --release panorama-2026-03-17-07 --target gpu-pool-3 --grace 30s```
DeployBot: Halting rollout... status: halt_ok. Canary paused at 98%.
Tom (oncall): Executing rollback now. Running the command.
Maria (SRE): I'm watching logs and metrics. Starting drain on node-7.
Tom (oncall): rollback started — rolling nodes out incrementally.
Ashok (infra): Noted increased error stream when node-7 restarted, but drain completed.
Maria (SRE): rollback progress: 3/6 nodes reverted. p95 dropping: 2.4s -> 430ms after first node reverted. p99 still high but trending down. 5xx rate halved.
Tom (oncall): Rollback complete across gpu-pool-3. Confirming runtime version v0.9.2 on all nodes.
DeployBot: Rollback finished at 1812345850. Release panorama-2026-03-17-07 rolled back.
Maria (SRE): Post-rollback metrics: p95 140ms, p99 620ms, 5xx near baseline (+1%). Running a 10m watch.
Tom (oncall): Good. No visible customer-impacting incidents reported to CS yet, but some requests timed out during the spike. @Priya please check any open support tickets.
Priya (Customer Success): On it — pinging top 3 customers with heavy traffic this window. I'll prepare a short incident note and offer timeline/mitigation.
Lena (SRE Lead): Great. Action items: - Maria to own postmortem (root cause: kv-affinity kernel flag interaction) - Ashok to run a targeted test harness on gpu-pool-3 for kv_lock_hold under synthetic burst - Tom to fill incident timeline and handoff to next oncall in 45m
Tom (oncall): I'll hand off to "next-oncall" at 1812347999 with a short summary. Current status: mitigated, metrics healthy, 10m watch running.
Maria (SRE): Quick checklist: revert verified, no config drift, alerts muted for rollout, add regression test to CI to catch kv_lock hold > 500ms.
Priya (Customer Success): Notifying affected customers with ETA for postmortem. Will include that mitigation was rollback and system stable.
Lena (SRE Lead): If anything regresses during the watch, escalate back to pager immediately. Otherwise prepare postmortem draft and timeline. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident state -> mitigated (rollback). Incident ID: INC-2026-03-17-1812345679. Postmortem owner: Maria (SRE).
